Rust owns the native life"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cycle, windows, tray, notifications and signed updates; a supervised Node.js sidecar runs the compat"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ible DSH/Cordis runtime."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Capability | Side | Notes |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Interaction notifications | client | Subscribes to the sessions store; fires a browser desktop not"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ification when a session waits on an approval, question, or plan review. Click opens that session. |"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"
| `screen_capture` model tool | host | Captures the primary display and commits the screenshot into"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" the conversation as an image attachment. **Disabled by default** — see Consent. |

| Desktop settings | clien"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"t | A settings section for pet preferences: enable/disable, character (built-in robot / whale / cat "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"or a custom PNG), and size. |
| Native shell | app | Rust/Tauri app that supervises the DSH sidecar,"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" embeds the local Web UI in a frameless WebView2 window, and provides native workspaces, tray contro"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ls, companion windows and signed GitHub Releases updates. |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## How it plugs in"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- The package declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest (object form: `{ "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" }`) — "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"this is what dsh recognizes as an installable plugin. `dsh.client` declares the web platform and the"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime packages it injects.
- Host side registers the `screen_capture` model tool"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" only.
- Client side reads the sessions store and the `question/requested` interaction stream (via t"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"he `PendingWait.answer` channel) — it never registers a second `ctx.userQuestions` provider, so it w"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"orks against the published runtime with no slot conflicts.
- The client bundle is a single file wrap"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ped in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` handshake (see `build.mjs`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin ships as `@mixian/dsh-desktop-plugin` with a dual-face Cordis bundle (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh"},{"id":"p11s2","text":".client`). It is **not registered unless `screenCapture:"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" true`** is set explicitly in the profile patch:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The captured image is always surfaced back into the conversation for transparency — it is never sile"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"mage is always surfaced back into the conversation for transparency — it is never silently injected."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Run the desktop app"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Requires Node.js ≥ 22 and pnpm 11 (`corepack enable`)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- The plugin adds **no tokens** when idle: the notification watcher, canvas, desk pet, and settings "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"are client-side and read the sessions store; they never enter the model context.
- `screen_capture` "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"adds one model-facing tool with a short description; its output is an image block in a durable `tool"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"/result` event, subject to the same attachment limits as any image in the session. It requires a mod"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"el that accepts image input."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Screen capture is host-only and captures the primary display; multi-monitor and region capture are"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" not supported.

- Notifications fire as native OS notifications in the desktop shell and fall back to the browse"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"r desktop-notification API in the web runtime. The `Alt+Space` global quick panel is planned, not sh"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ipped.
